newsitem.title: CANADA: Mobil Canada pipeline has small oil spill.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Canada pipeline has small oil spill.

text.p: Mobil Corp unit Mobil Oil Canada said on Friday its crews were working to repair a small leak on the company's South Saskatchewan oil pipeline in the southwestern part of the province.
Mobil said about 35 cubic metres (220 barrels) spilled near Dollard, Saskatchewan, about 300 km southwest of Regina.
"All the crude was contained on-site and most was recovered last night. There were no injuries and the line is currently running at 98 percent capacity," Mobil said.

The South Saskatchewan Pipeline Co owns and operates the gathering and delivery system for oil produced in southwest Saskatchewan. Oil is collected through 51 leases, located within the various oil fields along the gathering system. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
